value.rationale: The published eco-evolutionary system is explicitly used to study seasonal interior loops; the new full-amplitude calibration explains an observable long-run strategic quantity. For pairwise games the fluctuation law proves an exact downward average-cooperation displacement, not just a local approximation, and the proved nonvacuous stable periodic branch gives its exact leading size. The precise invariant is tied to payoff feedback and is not a generic re-expression of a stationary equilibrium coordinate.
